# BC Web Creator

> BC Web Creator builds custom, fast, mobile-friendly, SEO-ready websites for small businesses. Based in Abbotsford, British Columbia, Canada. Serves businesses across British Columbia, and works with clients across Canada, the United States and the United Kingdom.

- Services: custom web design, web development, SEO and performance, e-commerce, ongoing support
- Process: Discovery Call, Design & Review, Build & Test, Launch & Support
- Timeline: a typical small business site takes 2–4 weeks from design approval to launch
- Pricing: depends on pages, features and integrations; most small business sites are a fixed-price package; free quote on request
- Response time: within one business day. Hours: Monday–Friday, 09:00–17:00 Pacific
- Contact: email bcwebcreator@gmail.com (email first)

- [Web design in Surrey and Langley](https://bcwebcreator.com/surrey-langley-web-design.html): trades, shops and service businesses
